fix-w07-site-1.goal: Since site-P5 merged, every email send in the PGlite tests hangs until its time limit: email footerFor(tx, ...) calls legalLinksFor(locale) -> site.getLegalLinks(locale), which reads through getAppDb() outside the open send transaction, and PGlite has one connection, so the read waits for the transaction that waits for it. Fix: (1) site: getLegalLinks(locale, db?: DbOrTx) — when db is given, return loadLegalLinks(db, locale) directly (no unstable_cache, which cannot take a transaction); without it keep the cached app-db read. Add a legal.test.ts case that calls it inside h.db.transaction with the tx and gets the links. (2) email: legalLinksFor(locale, tx) passes the tx through, and footerFor passes its tx. (3) Remove the two fix-w07-site-1 lines from docs/build/known-red.txt and run test/wave0-email.test.ts and modules/email/jobs.test.ts alone (--maxWorkers=1): both must pass, together with modules/site and modules/email.

Declare the keys per kind from the schemas in forms events.ts (only keys that kind data carries); keep the type AllowedEventKind and the exported names. Update compile.test.ts and crm-p1.catalogue.test.ts only where they pin the old shared list. Remove the segment-events line from docs/build/known-red.txt, then run (one worker) apps/web modules/crm/segments and packages/core src/crm; both must pass.

fix-w08-booking-2.goal: crm-P7 made crm getReceptionCard real, so apps/web/modules/booking/queries/attendance.test.ts (getCheckinCard and getCheckinDay: shows the scanned booking with its guests, the payment due and the window flags) still expects receptionCard: null, the fallback booking used while the crm function was a stub. Also: booking-P6 made booking privacy export and erase real, so apps/web/modules/booking/fix-w05-schema-1.schedules.test.ts (lists waitlist_entries next to bookings and keeps the handler shapes) fails: it calls the handlers with a fake tx {} and expects {} and []. Drop or rewrite those two assertions (check the registration shape instead) and remove its known-red line too.

fix-w09-commerce-1.goal: apps/web/modules/commerce/server/recurring.test.ts (commerce-P4b) fixes NOW = 2026-11-04T10:00Z, but makeProduct writes its price version with validFrom = the real now(), so after 10:00 UTC on 2026-11-04 (and every later day) no price is valid at NOW and 6 of 7 cases fail with ConflictError product_unavailable. Make the test independent of the wall clock: create the price version with validFrom well before NOW (or derive NOW from the real clock), keeping every assertion. Grep the other tests for the same pattern (a fixed NOW with factory rows stamped at the real clock) in modules/commerce and modules/credits and fix them the same way. Remove the fix-w09-commerce-1 line from docs/build/known-red.txt; run modules/commerce and modules/credits with one worker.
